title: Thinking on Absurdist Successes and 1000xResist — Success: Part 7
summary: Kahran and Divya unpack their conversation with Remy Siu and use 1000xResist as the launchpad to talk about how culture sets your tolerance for things that don't fully make logical sense. They compare Miyazaki's Howl's Moving Castle (a castle that moves for tax evasion), Sufjan Stevens' wordless Illinois musical, and a Wild Cards Lagrangian paper George RR Martin co-wrote with a physicist — and ask whether the demand for internal consistency is a leftover from the Enlightenment.
topics: Picasso could paint like Da Vinci
art that should make you feel not understand

intents.display: to think about absurdism, emotion and why art doesn't have to make sense
